headline: Anthropic Prepares for Stock Market Listing
summary: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is planning a stock market debut expected to rank among the largest initial public offerings in history. The Claude chatbot developer is preparing to list shares this week.
why: Anthropic is a high-profile generative AI developer competing directly with OpenAI and Google. Large tech IPOs serve as key gauges for public equity market appetite and valuation multiples.
